answer: Because the oasis index is updated at intake, a repeated commitment is a duplicate by construction, and the lagoon audit republishes the digest set at close. Filling 138 aliases thus needs 138 distinct prompts, so the operator pays the authoring cost per identity and cannot amortise one lookup. Each answer commits to a prompt that differs from every prompt already used this epoch, checked against a river index of commitments rather than against the text alone. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
